name: pi-local-extensions
description: Pi extensions maintained in one repository; each package can be installed independently.

scripts.build:pi: for dir in pi-delivery pi-fast-mode pi-prompt-state pi-palettes pi-context-prune pi-clarify pi-jobs pi-usage pi-unescape; do node scripts/build-pi.mjs "$dir"; done
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 pi-delivery/*.test.ts pi-palettes/*.test.ts pi-palettes/*.test.mjs pi-clarify/tests/*.test.ts pi-context-prune/tests/*.test.ts pi-jobs/tests/*.test.ts pi-unescape/tests/*.test.ts pi-usage/tests/*.test.ts pi-prompt-state/tests/*.test.ts
